text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Dura-san...!
I won't let you go!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan—
I won't let you get away...!!

text_block_list.name: Dura & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhh!!!!!!
(Uwooooah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was... an insanely heated race...!
Congratulations, Duramente--!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I knew it!
You're always my number one, Duraaaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Duramenteeeee!!
That was the greatest race everrrr!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...It's hot.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Fighting against a strong opponent sparked a fire within me.
It's burning hot... Is this what passion feels like?)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (However—it's not "everything.")

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black fought hard too!
She can still keep hot on Duramente's heels!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
My dream is you!
Kitasaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Kitasaaan Blaaaack~~~~~~!!
We'll keep cheering for you--!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dura-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I lost!
You're reeeally tough to beat!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Kitasan...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But! Next time, it's my turn to win.
You're not done running yet either, are you, Dura-san?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I... won't give in to my weak self anymore.
And I don't want to lose to my 'rival,' either!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: “—Let's race each other again, Dura-san!”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
We definitely will, again.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(I finally grasped it. The frenzy that Kitasan creates...
I must—pursue it.)
After finishing all the post-race care and preparations, just as I was about to leave the racecourse...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
we need to talk.

Looking at her earnest gaze,
I intuitively knew she had found the answer
to what she'd been pondering before the race.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
About the road ahead.
...I've thought about it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —This year as well, I'd like to focus domestically.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right.
I will not challenge the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.'"

The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe... Duramente's lifelong dream.
She must have believed that this year would finally be the year, but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
“...I want to become the dream
of everyone involved in Japanese racing.”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
First and foremost, I want to become the kind of special Umamusume
that everyone can entrust their hopes to.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been acknowledged by everyone yet.
Kitasan's presence made me realize that.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: In every race I run this year, I will show the 'strongest' that all of Japan hopes to see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Carrying those feelings—she will win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I feel truly sorry
towards you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "They had been making all sorts of preparations for the sake of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...If it's next year,
I might be past my prime.
Even so—
choice_data_list: It's okay, I believe in you.

text_block_list.text:
None of our preparations will go to waste.
That day will come—it just won't be this year.
There is no problem at all.
choice_data_list: Alright! First, I'll be the best in Japan!
Okay! First, let's be the best in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I knew
you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
There's one more person
I want to report to right away—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It's rare to see you at this hour.
You must be exhausted after your race, right?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, but before that...
Congratulations on winning the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So, what is it you need?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Groove-nee
has always watched over me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: From childhood all the way to now... Always.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...And?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
This year,
I will not challenge the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to tell you
first."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Could you tell me a little more
about what happened?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —I see, only after becoming Japan's strongest...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I understand full well that it is a rather vague yardstick.
However—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...You just keep on
growing, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well done,
Dura.
(Pop)

Air Groove gently pats Duramente on the head...
Her touch is remarkably tender.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Groove-nee?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Carrying someone's feelings on your shoulders
is a truly irreplaceable experience.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The joy on everyone's faces when I won
the Oaks—just as my mother did before me—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The joy when a junior I've been doting on
won the Queen Elizabeth II Cup,
which neither my mother nor I could ever win.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I know both of those paths.
...It was an irreplaceable experience.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I respect
your resolve.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You hold the wishes and feelings of others dear.
I'm... so proud of you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Big Sis Groove...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll entrust it to you as well.
――Become the strongest in Japan, Dura.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed,
I have received it safely."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Regarding our next target race—
choice_data_list: I wanted to suggest the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: There are many strong rivals entering this race.

text_block_list.text: I looked into it earlier, and Kitasan Black, Satono Crown, Cheval Grand... all the same members from New Year's will be gathering.

Satono Crown has announced she will challenge a race in Hong Kong next.
Upon her return, she will surely deliver a magnificent run.

Cheval Grand also won the GⅡ Hanshin Daishoten
as the favorite the other day.
She is steadily building both ability and confidence.
And—after today's defeat... Kitasan Black is bound to grow even stronger.
choice_data_list: It's the perfect race to prove who's the strongest in the country.
It's the perfect race to prove who's the strongest in the country.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"At the Takarazuka Kinen, I'll defeat my rivals...
and show everyone that I'm worthy of their expectations."
